verdict.rationale: Metronome's docs confirm you can create and manage bearer API tokens through the Metronome app, so issuing a dedicated credential for an agent is possible. Nothing in the evidence shows those tokens can be scoped, permission-limited or read-only, so the least-privilege core of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented token scopes or permissions, role-restricted or read-only keys, per-agent credential limits, independent corroboration.
